title: Pilaf with buttermilk chicken and pomegranate
description: Try Rick Stein’s simple but flavoursome rice pilaf with marinated chicken for an impressively low-effort family dinner.

items.raw: 2 large boneless chicken breasts, skin on
items.name: large boneless chicken breasts, skin on

items.raw: salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: About 2–4 hours before cooking, put the chicken breasts in a bowl with the buttermilk and garlic, cover and leave in the fridge to marinate.
steps.raw: About 2–4 hours before cooking, put the chicken breasts in a bowl with the buttermilk and garlic, cover and leave in the fridge to marinate.

steps.text: About 30 minutes before cooking, put the saffron in a bowl, pour over 2–3 tbsp hot water and leave it to bloom.
steps.raw: About 30 minutes before cooking, put the saffron in a bowl, pour over 2–3 tbsp hot water and leave it to bloom.

steps.text: In a saucepan with a lid, over medium heat, add the oil and fry the onion until soft. Add the rice and stir it into the oil. Add the saffron water and stock, then season with ½ teaspoon of salt and some black pepper. Put a lid on the pan, turn down the heat and simmer the rice for 10–12 minutes until the liquid has been absorbed.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220C/200C Fan/Gas 7. Remove the chicken from the marinade, put it in a baking dish and sprinkle with salt and the za'atar.

steps.text: Cook the chicken for 20–25 minutes, depending on the thickness of the breasts, or until cooked through.
